author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Get exclusive videos & early access on my Patreon: http://patreon.com/RyanGeorge

Did you know that YouTube has a Playables section where you can play games? I did, because I made a video about it once. I had not been back since, for obvious reasons. But for research purposes I returned recently, and they have added a lot of games. Most of them are bad. One of them is called Find The Vampire.

I played Find The Vampire to completion. It took 18 minutes of my life. In that time I discovered that vampires can disguise themselves as fridges, garbage cans, televisions, trees, and a chest in a dungeon for some reason. I also met the main villain, Doctor Cool, who had three things to say to me and said all three of them repeatedly. I completed the game. The ending was not special.

This is my report.
